name: Modern SEO - M2L2 GBP Landing Page Audit and Optimization
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 2 Three-Step Method](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-2-three-step-method) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Step 2 of the three-step method (about 7 minutes of speech). Make the page the GBP links to (usually the homepage) match the GBP. Do it a few days after the GBP review, once the client has confirmed final categories and services. Add content; do not delete what already ranks.

# Key concepts and checks
- **Title tag:** primary category and city first, brand at the end, 60 characters or less (AI can help fit it). The demo led with the business name.
- **H1:** include primary category and city. The demo H1 was just the brand.
- **NAP match:** name, address, phone on the page and in the footer must exactly match the GBP. The demo was missing the address and footer NAP.
- **Schema:** run the page through a schema markup validator; add correct LocalBusiness schema if missing.
- **Location content:** real content about the city or region served. "This is just a list of cities" is thin and does not work.
- **GBP map embed:** Google Maps, search the business, Share, Embed a map, copy the iframe.
- **Reviews embed:** separate from the map (the client had 385 reviews, none shown).
- **Clickable phone links** (tel:).
- **Do not delete working content.** Remove only thin parts like a bare city list; add content on secondary categories, core services and geography with a Claude writing prompt.

# Steps
1. Wait for client approval of GBP categories and services.
2. Check and rewrite title tag and H1.
3. Compare phone and address with the GBP; check the footer.
4. Validate schema.
5. Review location content.
6. Check map embed, reviews embed, tel: links.
7. Send results to the client, get permission, pass fixes to the developer, add new content.

# Notable quotes
- "We want to include the primary category and city name."
- "I'm not going to delete stuff that's working."

# How this applies to TAG clients
- First find which URL each [Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile) links to for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub), then run this checklist on it.
- **Alphalete:** titles and metas are set in [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) (Metasync), not Yoast; a known site-wide second H1 comes from the copy-delete-posts plugin overlay, which matters for the H1 check. Its helper mu-plugin outputs no standalone LocalBusiness node.
- **Summit AZ:** GHL dynamic number insertion shows pool numbers in the browser while HTML, schema and tel: links keep (480) 447-7008. Check page source, never disable the DNI snippet. The mu-plugin outputs Plumber/LocalBusiness schema only on "Service in City" pages, so the homepage needs its own schema check.
- Output a fix list (page, current value, proposed value) for Kim; client sites are read-only for Claude.

# Caveats and open questions
- The transcript says the phone was missing; the screen shows it was the address.
- "When these changes are made, we will see the rank map get better, almost guaranteed" is an unverified claim.
- The Claude writing prompt is on the course page, not in the video.
